definition.title: Assess the value of learning
definition.responsibility: Compare a best action now with finite study-and-response policies under explicit probabilities, consequences, costs and availability.
invariants: Probabilities are explicit assessments, never inferred from state counts.
Responses depend on an observable report, never the hidden state.
Study fees consume cash and are subtracted once from expected operating payoff.
Pure information value is reported only when the feasible action set is unchanged.
Reference records do not become accepted facts without an explicit declaration.
Recommendations are conditional risk-neutral monetary comparisons, not factual findings or permission to act.

caseDerivation: Priors cover every frozen module.state and payoffs cover every declared action/state cell.
Study inputs cover every declared study and every state/report likelihood cell, including explicit zeros.
Accepted facts use frozen typed attributes; optional reference records follow frozen module.recordTypes without becoming accepted facts.
Case inputs may vary cash, deadlines, durations, fees, distributions and declared sensitivity scenarios, not objective semantics or identities.
schema.description: This describes the installed validators and supported presence-restriction paths; it is not a complete JSON Schema.

structuralSlots.description: Declare beneficiary, common money/time units, horizon and the installed risk-neutral expected-money criterion.
Declare typed attributes that accepted facts can constrain.
Declare finite hidden situations with typed attributes.
Declare proposed learning identities and observable reports, including no-report outcomes where needed.
Bind business vocabulary, basis organization and report representations.
State the premises and conclusion boundary reviewed by people.

caseInputs.description: Supply a cash limit or explicitly omit the constraint with null.
Declare the source and scope of the assessed probabilities.
Supply a complete explicit state distribution.
Supply action deadlines and cash requirements.
Supply the complete operating payoff matrix.
Supply fees, durations and explicit report likelihoods.
Declare reviewed typed facts with their source.

responsibilities: Study comparisons against the best action now

app.name: Should we buy a readiness check before reserving freight?
app.description: Compare the feasible backup arrangement now with a registration check followed by a complete operationally eligible response to every possible result. Numerical inputs proposed by a fitted model require an explicit review before evaluation.

format: assess-value-of-learning/1
module:
  id: shipment-readiness-check-investment
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: "Should we buy a readiness check before reserving freight?"
  description: Compare the feasible backup arrangement now with a registration check followed by a complete operationally eligible response to every possible result. Numerical inputs proposed by a fitted model require an explicit review before evaluation.
  question: "Would a timely registration check improve our shipment choice while leaving a permitted complete response to every possible result?"
  boundary: "One bounded shipment, one verification purchase, then one complete direct or backup arrangement. Reserving before a late report is outside this two-stage model."
  metadata:
    catalog:
      domain:
        id: order-fulfillment
        label: Order fulfillment
        description: Review delivery commitments and shipment arrangements.
      useCase:
        id: review-first-shipment
        label: Review a first shipment
        description: Review one shipment before committing money to an arrangement.
    requiredCapabilities:
      - id: learning-execution-feasibility
        version: 1
  executionFeasibility:
    version: 1
  objective:
    criterion: risk-neutral-expected-money
    unit: USD cent
    timeUnit: minute
    beneficiary: Supplier responsible for this shipment
    horizon: This order revision through the Friday receipt commitment
  assumptions: [Readiness probabilities and report likelihoods are proposed from fictional history by a separately validated model and require explicit reviewer acceptance. The model prediction is not evidence of registration., Only complete arrangements that pass every mandatory planning check in every logically supported state may be chosen after a report., A zero probability does not remove a logically admitted situation or waive an operational requirement., "Arrangement payoffs are negative complete quoted expense, excluding the separately charged verification fee. There are no sales revenues or other consequences in this bounded comparison.", "A complete planning run at each report-and-response time supplies the eligibility matrix, including expense, cash and separate scoped purchase authority.", The verification fee is deducted once in expected cost and counted once in each branch expense and cash check., A result received after reservation cannot inform that reservation. A prior reservation followed by a later report needs a different multi-stage policy model., A hypothetical report never becomes an actual observation or an operating permission., The authoring reference case is a package-admission example only. Every actual comparison replaces its numerical inputs and planning eligibility with current reviewed inputs and fresh complete SDK planning runs.]
  attributes:
    - id: transportRegistered
      label: SP-A transportation registration
      type: boolean
  states:

      label: SP-A is registered for this shipment
      attributes:
        transportRegistered: true
    - id: not_registered
      label: SP-A is not registered for this shipment
      attributes:
        transportRegistered: false
  actions:
    - id: direct
      label: Reserve direct shipment through SP-A
      description: "The complete direct arrangement, with its preparation, receipt and release conditions."
    - id: backup
      label: Reserve backup shipment through SP-B
      description: The complete independently registered backup arrangement.
  studies:
    - id: registration_check
      label: Scoped registration check
      reports:
        - id: confirmed_registered
          label: Registration confirmed
          kind: report
        - id: confirmed_not_registered
          label: Nonregistration confirmed
          kind: report
        - id: no_result
          label: No usable verification result
          kind: no-report
  presentation:
    labels:
      baseline: Reserve without another check
      study: Verification option
      action: Complete shipment arrangement
      state: Transportation situation
      report: Verification result
    reports:
      comparison:
        title: Verification before reservation
        question: "Which available choice has the lowest expected cost while retaining a complete feasible response?"
      responses:
        title: Response to each verification result
        question: "Which complete arrangement remains permitted after each possible result?"
      inputs:
        title: Shipment and review basis
        question: "Which accepted operating checks and probability assessments support this comparison?"

domain.label: Order fulfillment
domain.description: Review delivery commitments and shipment arrangements.

useCase.label: Review a first shipment
useCase.description: Review one shipment before committing money to an arrangement.

objective.horizon: This order revision through the Friday receipt commitment

assumptions: Readiness probabilities and report likelihoods are proposed from fictional history by a separately validated model and require explicit reviewer acceptance. The model prediction is not evidence of registration.
Only complete arrangements that pass every mandatory planning check in every logically supported state may be chosen after a report.
A zero probability does not remove a logically admitted situation or waive an operational requirement.
Arrangement payoffs are negative complete quoted expense, excluding the separately charged verification fee. There are no sales revenues or other consequences in this bounded comparison.
A complete planning run at each report-and-response time supplies the eligibility matrix, including expense, cash and separate scoped purchase authority.
The verification fee is deducted once in expected cost and counted once in each branch expense and cash check.
A result received after reservation cannot inform that reservation. A prior reservation followed by a later report needs a different multi-stage policy model.
A hypothetical report never becomes an actual observation or an operating permission.

The authoring reference case is a package-admission example only. Every actual comparison replaces its numerical inputs and planning eligibility with current reviewed inputs and fresh complete SDK planning runs.
